profile.description: 64-row prefill FFN projection; cold FP16 GEMM with complete communication/output validation. Distinct workload and new baseline; not native model prefill.

timing_protocol.scope: one complete cold GEMM; warm repeated-input path failed output oracle

research.hypothesis: For the fixed cold profiles (zero warmups, one timed iteration), accumulate all four communication phases directly into res_tile in row-major order. After the last send and receive callbacks complete, transpose into the now-dead W_0_tile buffer and copy the full column-major result back to res_tile before exiting the timer. This removes the second Mt*Nt accumulator allocation while retaining contiguous vector FMAs. Kt>=Mt ensures packing fits. Target the 64-row FFN up and down projections.
research.falsification: Reject any outstanding communication at buffer reuse, truncated outputs, missing FP16 FMA/reduction terms, changed timer or PE budget, numerical or clean-shutdown failure, speedup below 1.05x, memory above 1.10x or failed six-case fresh paired confirmation. This destructive scratch reuse is only valid for the fixed zero-warmup single-iteration cold contracts; it is not a resident/repeated GEMM candidate.
